title: Deleted, and left in limbo

title: MacKenzie Scott gave $30m to housing nonprofit; a year later, it unveiled 10-year plan
content: In October 2024, MacKenzie Scott made headlines by donating $30 million to Housing Trust Silicon Valley via her Yield Giving fund. This substantial contribution will support various housing initiatives over the next decade, particularly focusing on enhancing homeownership assistance. Housing Trust has a successful track record, having already developed thousands of affordable homes in the Bay Area.

title: Father got 3 bigha in 1972; HC protects married daughter's land claim
content: In 1972, the Himachal Pradesh government allotted three bigha and two biswas of agricultural land in Shimla to a person under the Nautor rules for cultivation.  His wife died in 2012, leaving behind their only daughter, who subsequently approached the revenue authorities once again for issuance of the patta. Her request was reportedly rejected outright on the ground that married daughters were ineligible for land under the Nautor rules.

title: Rajasthan Royals star creates history, surpasses Gayle for highest T20 score
content: Lhuan-dre Pretorius has made T20 cricket history with his phenomenal score of 188 runs off 79 balls while playing for the Titans against the Knights. This feat breaks Chris Gayle's former record of 175 runs, showcasing Pretorius's exceptional talent as he maintained a striking rate of 237.97. His recent century for South Africa further underscores his remarkable consistency and prowess on the field.

title: Mississippi couple wins $41,920 after loggers cut 1,299 trees on their land
content: In a significant logging error, 1,299 trees were cut down on Gerald and Rhonda Smith's property in Mississippi. The Smiths meticulously recorded the extent of their loss through photographs and measurements, leading to legal proceedings. A court recognized the logging company's blatant negligence, awarding the couple $41,920. Expert surveyor J.T. Strickland confirmed the boundary lines, and the appeals court reaffirmed the lower court’s ruling, validating the Smiths' claims for damages.

title: Woman bought 94 acres in 1973, then state restricted 10 acres for 20 years
content: In a landmark decision, the North Carolina Supreme Court has resolved a crucial land dispute involving landowner Elizabeth Mata. The court ruled that the state’s long-standing restrictions on her property, stemming from a proposed highway project, constituted indefinite takings. This ruling mandates proper compensation under eminent domain principles. The determination of the exact compensation will now be delegated back to trial courts, marking an essential step in the legal proceedings.

title: Maryland homeowner gets $234,368 check for home; new law bans such offers
content: Effective October 1, Maryland introduced legislation banning unsolicited checks sent with home purchase offers. This initiative is designed to safeguard homeowners from misleading marketing strategies from property investors. Consumer advocates highlighted the risk of vulnerable owners being tricked into agreements upon receiving such checks. Historical precedents in consumer lending underline the necessity for legal protections, advising homeowners against accepting random financial items received through mail.

title: Six years after his $10 billion climate pledge, Jeff Bezos turns to the Pacific Ocean
content: Jeff Bezos’ Earth Fund has announced more than $25 million in new ocean conservation grants across five Pacific nations. The funding will support marine protection and sustainable management across more than 625,000 square miles. The latest awards bring the fund’s Pacific commitment to $63.3 million of its planned $100 million.

title: Software engineer turns childhood skill into $100-an-hour side hustle
content: Priyancka Jaiin reveals how her childhood love for mehndi has blossomed into a lucrative side hustle. While maintaining her career as a software engineer, she serves clients with mehndi designs for a variety of events. Her artistry not only brings joy to brides but also supports cancer patients and mothers-to-be. Emphasizing careful practice, Jaiin showcases that a simple hobby can evolve into a significant source of creativity and fulfillment.

title: Warring out, Pargat in: Has Congress solved Punjab crisis or set stage for another twist?
content: Amarinder Singh Raja Warring has resigned as the president of the Punjab Congress after more than four years. His resignation follows a prolonged period of infighting over leadership roles within the party. Both Charanjit Singh Channi and Warring have seen shifts in their status amid ongoing power struggles.  But has Congress really solved the Punjab crisis?

title: How Freddie Freeman's family shaped the Dodgers star's MLB journey
content: Freddie Freeman’s family has been with him on his baseball journey. His childhood was marked by the loss of his mother, Rosemary and father, Fred, who helped develop his swing. Years later, Freddie and Chelsea Freeman faced a serious health crisis when their son Maximus developed Guillain-Barré syndrome. His return preceded Freeman’s historic 2024 World Series performance and $1 million donation to CHOC.

title: Jey Uso vs Jimmy Uso vs Solo Sikoa net worth 2026: Who is richest?
content: Jey Uso's net worth is projected to be between four to five million dollars in 2026. Jimmy Uso's estimated fortune ranges between two to four million dollars during the same time period. Solo Sikoa's net worth is forecasted to be around three million dollars in 2026. Their earnings primarily come from WWE salaries and merchandise royalties associated with their wrestling careers.

title: Ohio man allegedly took $3m from investors for fake ticket scheme
content: An Ohio man pleaded guilty to running a fake investment scheme that prosecutors say defrauded five victims in Ohio and Florida of more than $3 million. John E. Brown II promoted supposed “rolling code ticket packages” linked to sports and theme-park experiences, but the investment did not exist. Prosecutors said he used investors’ money for personal expenses, including about $1.375 million in casino transfers.

title: Ohio farmer with $1m medical debt sold land after officials blocked solar lease
content: In Ohio, farmer Wayne Greier's financial struggles intensified when a planned solar project fell through due to local resistance and new rules, leaving his family's renewable energy plans in jeopardy. Compounded by $1 million in medical debt from recent health issues, Greier was forced to offload land and equipment, jeopardizing his farming business. He has emerged as an advocate for farmers' property rights to help protect others from similar hardships.

title: From papads to pitches: NCERT brings startup lessons to Class IX
content: A new chapter on startups and entrepreneurship has been introduced for Class IX students in NCERT textbooks. The chapter emphasizes the growth of India's startup ecosystem over the past decade. It includes important lessons on identifying business opportunities and creating effective business plans. Entrepreneurial stories, including those of Lijjat Papad and Mohan Singh Oberoi, illustrate key concepts.

title: Akhilesh's Rajya Sabha picks: SP's master strategy or 'PDA' contradiction?
content: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav's Rajya Sabha picks, including uncle Ram Gopal Yadav and Reliance executive Dhanraj Parimal Nathwani, are being seen as an early test for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly polls. The nominations raise questions over the SP's PDA strategy, its broader political outreach and a possible third Rajya Sabha candidate, despite the party's numbers falling short of the winning quota.

title: Kevin O’Leary-backed Utah AI data center plan downsized after local backlash
content: Kevin O’Leary-backed plans for a 40,000-acre AI data centre district in Utah have been cut to about 20,000 acres after strong local opposition. Residents have raised concerns over the project’s energy and water use, environmental impact and public review. Developers say the project could create thousands of jobs and support US computing and national defence.

title: AI and the monk: Anthropic goes for swami and friends to tame Claude
content: Anthropic engaged various religious scholars and philosophers to explore ethical frameworks for advanced AI development. The discussions included considerations about potential moral status and consciousness in AI like Claude. Participants included Swami Sarvapriyananda, who has addressed the distinctions between intelligence and consciousness. The aim is to incorporate values from multiple faith traditions into AI training processes.

title: Mohsin Naqvi to skip India-Pak Asian Games gold medal match due to 'prior commitments'
content: The ACC confirmed that Naqvi will miss the final at Korogi Park because of "prior commitments". India and Pakistan will meet for the gold medal after Sri Lanka and Bangladesh play the bronze-medal match.

title: SIR under review: Former SC, HC judges to examine 'validity' of voter roll revision
content: A panel of five former judges is being formed to review the Election Commission's Special Intensive Revision. The Lawyers Association for Constitution emphasizes the panel's independence in assessing the review's validity and impact. Senior lawyers are expected to provide strategic legal advice to the panel throughout the process. The Election Commission has also initiated a drive to identify and re-enrol excluded eligible voters.

title: Assam nightclub horror: Woman stripped, kicked on floor; manager detained

The nightclub's manager has been detained for questioning following the event. Police officials confirmed that they will take legal action after investigating the case. The identity of the victim remains unknown as authorities continue to gather information.

title: Israeli investigators to question Omani co-pilot in UAE-led flydubai probe: Report

The investigation is led by UAE authorities to determine the motives and background of the co-pilot. The attack occurred during flydubai flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv, resulting in an emergency landing. The Indian captain was stabbed but managed to regain control and land safely.

title: Anti-CEC protests: Rahul says lathi can stop a crowd, but not a question
content:
Rahul said thousands of youngsters were protesting peacefully against 'vote chori' and the resignation of CEC Kumar to save democracy, but the Modi-Shah government replied by dragging the boys and girls through the streets and arresting them.

NEW DELHI: Slamming the police action on protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar on Gandhi Jayanti, Congress Lok Sabha MP Rahul Gandhi on Friday said the CEC will ultimately be forced out, as would be the system that appointed him. “He will go. Because a lathi can stop a crowd, but not a question,” the leader of the opposition said. On X, Rahul said thousands of youngsters were protesting peacefully against “vote chori” and the resignation of CEC Kumar to save democracy, but the Modi-Shah government replied by dragging the boys and girls through the streets and arresting them. “That is what Bapu taught us – speak the truth and fight peacefully. And that is what scares the govt the most,” he added.

title: Ex-CEC says deleted voters can't use Form 6; EC cites rules to counter claim
content: every claim for the inclusion of a name in the roll, to be lodged within 30 days from the date of publication of the draft roll under Rule 10, 'shall be in Form 6 and signed by the person desiring his name to be included in the rolling' former chief election commissioner (CEC) S Y Quraishi on friday claimed that Form 6 cannot be filled by a deleted voter .

title: Prison room, bed, newspaper — That is ‘baron’ Veeramani’s world now
content: R Veeramani, 84, is now a goondas Act detenue facing four child rape cases . he is today a VIP inmate housed at the high security block . video shows him walking along a CCTV-monitored corridor .

title: With President’s nod, Gujarat becomes second state after Uttarakhand to get UCC
content: the legislation also regulates live-in relationships by making their registration compulsory and requiring formal notification of their termination . the state government will now frame and notify the rules required for enforcing the legislation . it will not apply to members of Scheduled Tribes, whose customary rights are protected under the Constitution .

title: Over 10,000 turn up for CJP’s anti-CEC protest at Mumbai's Shivaji Park
content: despite the police’s denial of permission, over 10,000 protesters gathered at dadar’s Shivaji Park on friday . the crowd, estimated between 9,000 and 10,000, remained largely peaceful . in the hot and humid weather, protesters said, “Mumbai police we love” .

title: Hindi on Tamil Nadu highway sign board stirs row, 2 engineers suspended
content: the board displayed Tirunelveli, Alwarthirunagari, Thoothukudi and Tiruchendur in Tamil, Hindi and English . it was installed at Valliammalpuram on the Sathankulam-Nazareth section of SH-93 .

title: India reviews security SOPs, measures after flydubai event
content: intelligence agencies are closely monitoring developments after initial findings attributed the hijacking attempt to radicalisation . the Indian security and intelligence establishment is on alert following the failed hijacking of a flydubai flight . security authorities are reassessing both ground-level passenger screening, cockpit access vulnerabilities and in-flight countermeasures .

title: Two suspected Pakistani intruders shot dead in Tarn Taran
content: the incident occurred near the border out post at Rajoke village under Khalra police station . no officer came on record to comment on the incident, citing policy restrictions . the two men allegedly continued moving towards the Indian side, following which BSF personnel opened fire .

title: From hospital bed, Captain Smit tells PM Modi: Couldn’t let others die
content: smit Machchhar says his thoughts were fixed on saving all 174 passengers . he made a final push to open the cockpit door, allowing others to overpower the attacker and steer the plane to safety . in his first publicly available account, he spoke from his hospital bed to PM Narendra Modi .

content: the UT has identified 28 places and features in ladakh by standard names on the official map of the survey of India . among the 28 are places in Aksai Chin and Gilgit-Baltistan in POK, which India treats as part of Ladakh .

title: 5 Indian nationals rescued after Kuwait tanker hit in Strait of Hormuz
content: five Indian nationals aboard a Kuwait-flagged crude oil tanker were safely rescued . the vessel was struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz . embassy in Oman said all five had been safely shifted ashore .

title: From Shiv-on to off: Musk’s half-Indian partner goes into ex space
